CustomField.label: Fix Message
CustomField.description: Optional next-step guidance displayed in the detail for a failed check. Tell the user what to review or change, using language that is specific to the failed requirement. Supports merge tokens such as {!record.Name}, {!record.Owner.Name}, and {!rhcResult.foundValue}. Pair it with an Action URL when a useful page, record, report, or playbook can take the user directly to that next step.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional guidance after a failure. Tokens: {!record.FieldApiName}, {!rhcResult.foundValue}. Pair with Action URL when useful.
